author: musho7-dev
subject: Per-car traits, stats and upgrades; view cars before buying
body:
- Every car has a unique trait (e.g. Fuel miser, Unstoppable, Air kart)
  with its own speed/power/grip/air/fuel modifiers
- Upgrades (engine, tires, shocks, fuel tank) are now per car; old
  shared upgrade levels are copied to each owned car on first load
- Upgrade prices scale with the car's price
- Garage shows the selected car's name, trait and 5 stat bars
- Tapping a car you don't own previews it (stats + parked in the
  background) with a BUY / Cancel bar instead of buying instantly
